leadText: Sean Schemmel is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of .
plainText:
Sean Schemmel is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Schemmel was born on November 21, 1968, in Waterloo, Iowa. His father left his mother while she was still pregnant with him, leaving Schemmel to be raised by a stepfather. He attended and graduated from North Texas State University, after which he pursued a voice acting career. Schemmel first joined the series during the sixth season. As with most other voice actors who worked with 4Kids Entertainment, he left when and TAJ Productions took over the dubbing and distribution of the series. As of Nosing 'Round the Mountain!, Schemmel has returned to provide voices for many more characters.

Schemmel had moved to Los Angeles at some point during the , and after a long absence, returned to once more in Pokemon Journeys: The Series, starting with Raid Battle in the Ruins!, in which he has always been uncredited as providing his voice role as Ash's Dracovish. Schemmel returned to being credited during . Schemmel is currently affiliated with Arlene Thornton & Associates.

==Trivia==
Schemmel voices two leaders of villainous teams; Archie of Team Aqua and Cyrus of Team Galactic.
Schemmel voiced Alva in a trailer for Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel, but in the final product, Alva was voiced by Billy Bob Thompson.
